note: One row of a document's history (CANVAS-27). The number is for people and for pinning a reveal; it is NEVER a concurrency token (CANVAS-34). The handoff's label ('v3') and display time ('7:36 PM') are not on the wire: a client derives both.

valid.name: the GM's open working version: a burst of autosaves reads as one entry (CANVAS-34)
a version that changed nothing a reader can name

invalid.name: the handoff's label and display time
invalid.why: CANVAS-27: a number and an ISO timestamp; the label and the clock face are the client's

invalid.name: an author that is neither the GM nor the assistant
invalid.why: AUD-1: one GM per campaign and players cannot write; the two authors are a closed set

invalid.name: sealed left out
invalid.why: CANVAS-34 and REVEAL-8: only a sealed version can be pinned or exported, so a client must never have to guess

invalid.name: a summary of 201 characters
invalid.why: a summary is one line of at most 200 characters

invalid.name: a changed field that is not a field key
invalid.why: field keys are flat snake_case; the handoff's ifAttacked is if_attacked

invalid.name: a path into a field
invalid.why: CANVAS-19: a field is a top-level key and the unit of change; there are no sub-field paths

invalid.name: restored from itself or from the future
invalid.why: CANVAS-26: a restore appends a NEW version equal to an EARLIER one

invalid.name: restored_from left out
invalid.why: null says 'not a restore'; a missing key says nothing
